#  14451 - Drawing and Painting - Print workshop Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **14451**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Drawing and Painting - Print workshop**  |  
|  Zeichnen und Malen - Druckwerkstatt   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 6 - Architecture, Civil Engineering and Urban Planning   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dipl.-Ing. Lundqvist, Anna 
  * Prof. Issel, Verena 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  On special announcement   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The aim of the module is to broaden students' artistic horizons by exploring various artistic techniques in the field of letterpress, silk screen printing, riso printing and intaglio printing.The focus is on the development of analytical-synthetic image strategies and the development of differentiated perception and extended representation skills in relation to the use of graphic structures. We aim to develop zines and artistic publications- medium and contents will be discussed and aligned.  |  
| Contents:  | Students work independently on printmaking-oriented image concepts. Various artistic printing techniques are presented in short lectures and their systematic and art-historical context is explained. The facilities of the print workshop are explained in practical and technical instructions.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | none  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | none  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | none  |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * 1 Zine, 25%
  * 1 Screeen Printing, 25%
  * 1 Coin Sculpture, 25%
  * 1 Presentation, 25%

In the first course, the exminations are specified in terms of time and content.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Architektur / keine PO 
  * Abschluss im Ausland / Stadtplanung und Städtebau / keine PO 
  * Master (research-oriented) / Urban Design and Sustainable Revitalization / PO 2024 

 |  
| Remarks:  | none  |  
| Module Components:  | Seminar: Drawing and painting - Print workshop   |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment
